Name: Bootleg NES Chrono Trigger Frog

Description:
File contains both character & portrait. Make a backup of your original files.

Specifically:
[Stardew Valley Directory]\Content\Characters\Dwarf.xnb
[Stardew Valley Directory]\Content\Portrait\Dwarf.xnb

[[AFTER BACKUP]] - Extract .zip file, drag extracted Contents folder to the Stardew Valley folder. 

This is not a SMAPI mod, this will replace the files stated above. 

I did not include a copy of the original sprites as they are the property of the dev.
